explanation: Flush volume = 3 × (pi × r1² × L1 × 1000 + pi × r2² × L2 × 1000). Substitute the stated values: 3 × (3.1416 × 0.125 × 0.125 × 100 × 1000 + 3.1416 × 0.075 × 0.075 × 200 × 1000) = 25329.15 L. Round only the final result to 2 decimal places. The result uses the assumptions stated in the question.
formula: Flush volume = 3 × (pi × r1² × L1 × 1000 + pi × r2² × L2 × 1000)
